name: 19611 · Reading, PA
findings: ZIP 19611 (Reading) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19611 (Reading) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19611 (Reading) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
